title: Not sure if it's the mallworld
content: So this is a dream I had a quite long time ago but I still remember it and when I found this sub it reminded me of it. Not sure if it's your mall world tho so I would like to hear your opinión on it. I had a strange dream where I was stuck in a hospital I think, not sure what the building was, a mall maybe? It was a huge place.... Actually, it was some kind of school because I remember there were teachers there, but the thing is that it seemed like a horror movie because everyone was a bit... not 100%, let's say. Now, I tried to find a way out of there or at least understand what the hell was going on there. I walked everywhere and I didn't find anything that led me to an answer. It was just full of people who were behaving really strangely, like there was one person who always sneezed on you and then always another person came in after him and he was armed with masks and shouted "the Corona virus" or something. There were full of strange people. I remember wanting to go to the police station there or go into all kinds of no-entry corridors but I felt fear and I knew I cant trust the police. So I entered a staircase that was huge, I didn't even know it was that high, and then I realized it was a dream, I wasn't actually going to go up all the stairs on foot, so I just slowly made myself fly up until I felt my whole body collapsing into itself again, only this time I kept dreaming and it became crazy weird, because all the stairs started to blur and it felt like a never-ending ladder. The whole world turned upside down and I didn't know what was up and what was down and I completely lost my sense of direction. I was just wandering in the air with a lot of stairs around me and then I saw a *huge* TV screen open in front of me and there was some character there who said something like, "Here's the software we've been working on all this time... a game.. something.. " and this is it. She's talking about our world and then I felt like I'm not part of it and I'm a glitch. I remember I was thinking about how I wasn't supposed to be there and I got to a really forbidden place and she was going to say something important, I mean, I knew it was a dream. And I said, okay, she's going to tell me something important about us as humans in our world. I have to listen, remember, and write quickly when I wake up, so that's what I managed to write. I don't think I was supposed to hear that we're software. But from what she said, we're really a small collection of higher beings or something.
